note: Roblox badges for 10 achievements. Create each on the Creator Dashboard (Monetization -> Badges) with this name, description and icon, then put the badge id into game/ReplicatedStorage/Config/AchievementConfig.luau BadgeIds[id]. Until then awarding is a no-op. Players who unlocked an achievement earlier get its badge on their next join.

badges.name: First Call
badges.description: You finished your very first call. Welcome to Station 67, firefighter!

badges.name: First Rescue
badges.description: You saved someone from a fire. You're a real hero!

badges.name: Save the Panda
badges.description: You carried a panda out of a burning house. The panda says thank you!

badges.name: Cat in a Tree
badges.description: You climbed up and got the cat down from the tree. Meow!

badges.name: Night Hero
badges.description: You won a call in the dark. Your helmet light saved the day!

badges.name: Speed Run Record
badges.description: You set a new speed record on a call. Super fast!

badges.name: Combo Master
badges.description: You and your friends hosed the same fire 25 times. Teamwork!

badges.name: YEET!
badges.description: You threw someone to safety. Wheee!

badges.name: Level 25
badges.description: You reached level 25. You're a top firefighter!
